purpose: After the complete 1,483-event Phase-1 signal-time annotation ledger was frozen without outcomes, expose only the 2018-2019 signal cohorts to anonymous coarse outcome buckets and full post-signal paths for visual attribution. Preserve every 2020 signal outcome as a sealed temporal holdout until a separate objective numeric rule is frozen.

workflow_precedent.principle_reused: Start from an economically interpretable mother signal, inspect complete pre/post chart anatomy, compress recurring causal-time observations, then translate those observations into a small deterministic numeric rule before a later temporal block is opened.
workflow_precedent.principle_not_reused: No V26 gap or corridor condition is imported into V34R1, and no retrospective outcome-derived chart label is itself executable.

required_authorization.activation_condition: The runner must fail before every external path access unless one exact CY-056 asset and bounded authorization bind this spec, this runner, every frozen repository input, every frozen Phase-1 public artifact, and the four declared Stage-B identities with the exact permission booleans above.

temporal_holdout_seal.shared_parquet_rule: After exact authorization, the immutable outcomes and future-path files may be hashed as whole files, but SQL must project and fetch only rows whose event signal date is before 2020-01-01 and belongs to the frozen 915-event set.
temporal_holdout_seal.calendar_2020_completion_context: A calendar-2020 path row is allowed only when it completes the plus-126 path of a 2019 signal. It is not a 2020 holdout event and cannot be pooled with, compared with, or used to infer the sealed 2020 signal cohort.
temporal_holdout_seal.stage_b_result_boundary: The Stage-B result aggregates the sealed 2020 cohort. Its path and SHA are declared for lineage only; the Phase-2A runner may never resolve, stat, hash, open, or parse it.
temporal_holdout_seal.future_holdout_open: A separate rule-freeze contract must bind an objective signal-time formula and its hashes before any 2020 outcome/path row is read.

frozen_stage_b_binding.execution: First legal fully valid non-upper-limit coordinate open in global sessions signal+1 through signal+3; +10 percent target; strict H20 fallback with open processed before same-day target; T+1; 40 bps round trip; no stop.

chart_contract.event_coverage: Every one of the 915 frozen 2018-2019 events exactly once; no 2020 event; each event must have exactly the raw relative sessions +1 through +126 before any display-validity filtering.
chart_contract.left_panel: The exact immutable 720x440 Phase-1 anonymous signal-time chart (-126..0), hash-verified per ledger. It contains adjusted OHLC, turnover and the causal broad-market line but no identity, date, industry, yield or outcome.
chart_contract.right_panel: An independently scaled 720x440 adjusted-coordinate post path (+1..+126) reconstructed from the frozen Stage-B future path. Raw OHLC geometry is audited exactly and display OHLC uses adjusted_close*(raw_price/raw_close), preserving equality and order without clipping or tolerance. +1..+20 is primary attribution; +21..+126 is context. Entry, target and exit markers are attribution only.
chart_contract.post_turnover: Not rendered because the frozen Stage-B future-path artifact does not carry turnover. No new raw-data source is introduced merely to add it.
chart_contract.outcome_display: One coarse outcome bucket only; no numeric return.
chart_contract.contact_sheets: 5x5, grouped by one frozen outcome bucket
chart_contract.publication: Same-parent temporary staging, no-overwrite output, complete hash revalidation, exactly-once coverage, then Darwin RENAME_EXCL atomic exclusive rename; fail closed if that primitive is unavailable or the target exists.

definitions.IMMEDIATE_ACCEPTANCE: A clear sustained upward response begins in +1..+5 and remains accepted through the relevant H20 path or reaches the target without earlier decisive rejection.
definitions.DELAYED_ACCEPTANCE: After early basing or a recoverable pullback, a clear sustained upward response begins in +6..+20.
definitions.EARLY_REJECTION: A clear sustained downside break begins in +1..+5 and is not promptly reclaimed by +10.
definitions.LATE_REJECTION: No early rejection; the path is initially stable or favorable, but a clear sustained downside break begins after +5 and by +20.
definitions.CHOP_OR_AMBIGUOUS: No clear sustained acceptance or rejection in +1..+20, or conflicting path evidence prevents a directional label.
definitions.NO_COMPLETED_TRADE: Mandatory when the frozen lifecycle is not completed or net return is nonfinite.

phase2a_review_schema.evidence: One concrete line, no symbol/date/industry/yield/numeric return.

discovery_interpretation.primary_morphology: Discovery prompt only. Any apparent base, trend, extension, or breakdown relation must later be translated into a causal numeric signal-time predicate.
discovery_interpretation.market_tape: Discovery prompt only. Any apparent broad-tape relation must later be translated from the same-day-and-prior causal cross-sectional market series.
discovery_interpretation.turnover_state: Discovery prompt only. Any apparent dry-up or expansion relation must later be translated from signal-time-and-prior registered turnover values.
discovery_interpretation.signal_candle: Descriptive only and permanently forbidden from rule formation because Phase-1 inter-reviewer reliability failed its ex-ante gate.
discovery_interpretation.post_path_label: Outcome attribution only and permanently forbidden from predictor formation.
discovery_interpretation.outcome_bucket: Outcome attribution only and permanently forbidden from predictor formation.

future_rule_translation_boundary.maximum_final_ruleset: One simple causal candidate containing at most five independently interpretable numeric clauses.
future_rule_translation_boundary.translation_requirement: Before any 2020 outcome is accessed, every retained visual observation must be rewritten as an exact formula computed only from rows available no later than signal_at, with one fixed lookback, one fixed threshold, orientation, missing-data behavior and PIT lineage.

objective_primitive_examples_not_authori.morphology: Fixed-window adjusted-return efficiency, fixed-window range width, fixed-window drawdown, or fixed-window distance from a prior high/base.
objective_primitive_examples_not_authori.market: Fixed-window return or slope of the same causal same-day cross-sectional median market line displayed in Phase 1.
objective_primitive_examples_not_authori.turnover: One fixed recent-versus-prior turnover ratio or same-day causal cross-sectional rank.

required_separate_artifacts_before_holdo: one frozen rule specification with at most five clauses

future_economic_gate.development_gate_before_holdout: For each year separately, the frozen objective candidate must have more than 50 completed signals and mean net return greater than 4 percent under the unchanged +10 percent/H20/40-bps lifecycle.
future_economic_gate.holdout_gate: Without modifying any clause, 2020 must independently have more than 50 completed signals and mean net return greater than 4 percent under the same lifecycle.
future_economic_gate.failure_action: Fail closed; do not rescue with threshold changes, neighboring windows, signal-candle conditions, post-path conditions, or a second look at 2020.
future_economic_gate.claim_if_passed: Temporal holdout confirmation inside the already consumed pre-2021 research era, not validation on post-2020 or untouched production history.

outcome_access_sequence: verify exact CY-056 registry asset/authorization and literal bindings without external access
verify frozen non-outcome Phase-1 corpus and identity-only ledger columns
hash and parse prepared pre-signal identity; reconstruct all 1,483 opaque keys in memory
discard 2020 signal identities before attaching any Phase-1 chart path or label
hash outcomes and future paths; never touch Stage-B result
SQL INNER JOIN both outcome and path reads to the frozen 915 event IDs before fetch; limit signal dates before 2020 and nullable entry/exit/path dates no later than 2020-12-31
render 915 anonymous charts and coarse buckets
reverify all allowed hashes and atomically publish
prohibited: statting, hashing, opening or parsing Stage-B result in Phase-2A
fetching any outcome or path row for a 2020 signal
persisting or displaying event_id, symbol, date, year, industry, payout yield or any identity crosswalk
displaying or persisting a numeric return
rewriting a Phase-1 annotation after an outcome is available
using a post-signal path label, entry, target, exit or outcome bucket as a predictor
testing label combinations, parameter grids, neighboring thresholds, rule subsets, portfolio replay or candidate reselection
opening the 2020 holdout before a separately hashed objective rule freeze and authorization
next_action: Install a separately reviewed CY-056 manifest/registry authorization, run only the bound renderer, review every one of 915 anonymous Phase-2A charts, then freeze a separate objective translation contract before any 2020 holdout read.
